reference.action_sheet: CSS .sheet desktop centers at 340px; phone aligns to bottom with safe-area padding; options have 56px minimum height; Cancel is separate.

actual.prompt_confirm: Confirm uses ProductModal with Cancel/confirm rows; ProductPromptField supports multiline notices and keyboard handling.
